title: Request Freight Pickup | Vidhi Transport Gujarat & Maharashtra
description: Prepare a road-freight pickup request with origin, destination, cargo, package, weight and handling details for Vidhi Transport.

hero.title: Tell us what is ready, where and when.
intro: Prepare a complete pickup message for the Vidhi Transport operations team. A request is confirmed only after the team reviews and accepts it.
list: Keep package count, weight and dimensions ready.
Use exact pickup and destination PIN codes.
State any forklift, crane or dock requirement.
Declare regulated or specialised material accurately.
Send the prepared request Choose WhatsApp, email or copy.
Operations review The team checks route, cargo and availability.
Clarification if needed Special handling or documents may be requested.
Pickup confirmation Proceed only after receiving confirmation.

faqs.q: Does submitting a pickup request confirm a vehicle?
faqs.a: No. The prepared request must be sent to Vidhi Transport, and the team must review the cargo, route, schedule and vehicle availability before confirming the pickup.

faqs.q: Which cargo details should I include?
faqs.a: Include the exact material, package type and count, total weight, dimensions, stackability, loading method and any classification, document or handling requirement.

faqs.q: Can I request PTL and FTL assessment together?
faqs.a: Yes. Select ‘Please recommend’ and provide complete shipment information so the team can assess the practical movement options.
